requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online, selecting services, barbers, and available time slots without overlaps.
Customers should have the option to easily change or cancel their appointments online through a simple interface.
An automated reminder system should send notifications to customers one day and one hour before their appointments via SMS and email to reduce no-shows.
Customers should have the option to create accounts to save their details and booking history for faster future bookings.
